note: Who the portal says an account is, and the pair the client's login message will carry. This is this project's own and it is temporary: a real identity store is a schema decision and the login database has no account table yet. A name not listed answers the reference's own refusal: 400 who are you?

accounts.doc: The name this machine's client types, with the password 123. It is first because a client asked to log in as it and the server refused while the name was absent.
A second name, so that a test can log in as somebody and still be somebody else.
